meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文稿或设计图做成动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把网页设计或文字内容做成生动视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn your design or text into motion video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn web designs or text into engaging videos

howto.what: 用户要求制作、修改或渲染视频/动画/动态图形时，本技能先看有无旧项目或简报，没有就问主题，再选定对应工作流（如幻灯片、字幕等）。它把内容做成带时间标记的网页文件并渲染成视频；已有项目的检查、发布也由它负责。
howto.when: 当用户请求制作、修改或渲染视频/动画/动态图形，或对已有 HyperFrames 项目进行检查、预览、发布等时触发；用户选用其他框架或只要求录制浏览器会话时除外。

say.text: 把这个产品网页URL做成推广视频。
给这段采访视频加字幕，画面不要改。

say.note: 直接走移植流程，跳过意图访谈。

howto.what_en: On video/animation requests, this skill checks existing project state, asks the topic if none, picks matching workflow, and writes a timed HTML composition rendered to video; also handles inspecting/publishing existing projects.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create, edit, animate, or render a video/animation, or to inspect or publish a HyperFrames project; not when they pick another framework or only record a browser session.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from this product website URL.
Add captions to this interview clip without changing the footage.
Port this Remotion project to HyperFrames.
say_en.note: Goes straight to porting, skipping the intent interview.
